summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py with one parametrized test over valid and invalid graph cases plus a separate parametrized test for None and plain-string inputs. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (40 passed) under the shared venv. Nothing is committed and no existing files changed. Not verified: mypy, black, isort, and ruff were unavailable in the venv and were not installed. The '# type: ignore[unreachable]' on the non-node guard in shacl.py is unverified and should be removed if mypy does not flag it.
